title: dep-scan corpus manifest
description: The labelled corpus the scorer (contrib/corpus/score.py) and the CI join-eval jobs read. Every item is fetchable or committed, carries a digest, and names a label file whose sections each carry their own source.

notProduced.description: Finding categories dep-scan does not produce yet, each with the issue that tracks it. The score table shows them as gaps rather than leaving them out.

digest.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 without a prefix. For repository items this is the digest of `git archive --format=tar <commit>`; for image items the hex form of the image manifest digest; for fixture items the digest of the fixture directory as `contrib/corpus/score.py --digest-fixture <dir>` computes it.

source.description: Where the input comes from: `<url>@<commit>` for a repository, `<image>@sha256:<hex>` for an image, `fixture:<name>` for a fixture committed under contrib/corpus/fixtures/.

digestNote.description: Present only where the digest of a public upstream manifest does not verify with the current git, for example a tar whose long paths force pax headers formatted differently across git versions.

testdata.description: The repo-test artifact this item's inputs are served as, when one exists.

artifact.description: Project name in contrib/repotests/projects.json and testdata.lock.json.

digest.description: The OCI manifest digest the lock file pins.

subset.description: Present when the pull-request CI job can run this item today: committed fixtures and repo-test artifacts that are already published.

labels.description: The item's label file beside this manifest.

scan.description: The scan dep-scan runs on the item. `types` are the project types (empty for a BOM directory scan, which reads the types off the BOMs); `args` are further command line arguments; `bomDir` is a sub-path of the item's data holding pre-generated BOMs to scan instead of the source.
